import re

def f(s):
    # Extract the initials from the string using regex
    initials = re.findall(r'[A-Z]', s)
    
    # Capitalize the first letter of each initial
    initials = ''.join(char.upper() for char in initials)
    
    # Construct the final string with the capitalized initials
    result = ''.join([initials[i] + s[i + 1] if i % 2 == 0 else s[i] + initials[i + 1] for i in range(len(initials) + len(s))])
    
    return result
